bestBets.overview: Track is rated soft 5 at the time of acceptances with a forecast for mostly fine weather. WINSTON'S PRIDE looks hard to beat here but he is becoming costly to the punters. He steps up to 2000m for the first time today. DIDACTIC wore blinkers for the first time when runner-up to Mandarin last week. ARES FLIGHT drops in grade after finishing midfield behind Suit Of Wands over this trip at Strathalbyn. CHILLY BRO ran an improved race when rising to 1600m here last week. The 2000m journey should be more to his liking.

raceTips.comment: Winston’s Pride was runner-up behind Extra Chill and then 3rd behind Mandarin here last week as fav. He’s been placed at five of nine. Didactic looks the danger he was good last week when 2nd behind Mandarin. The 2000m is ideal. Son Of Vadamos run 4th at Mildura last time and draws a nice barrier. It’s A Solid Deel has been racing well at Port Augusta.

bestBets.overview: EMPIRE RULER ran a much-improved race to place at Strathalbyn when resuming for a new stable. Noel Callow takes the ride today. BLABBER MOUTH came from a long way back in the field to finish fifth this route when resuming in April. Watch market moves for her fresh. RICH MELODY hit the line well when placed behind Dirty Deal two starts ago. He was forced to cover ground at Strathalbyn last time and finished midfield. RED RIPPLES has been around the mark in both runs back from a break and looks suited rising to 1600m. KHORASAN and PRETTY MORSEL are others with claims for multiples.

raceTips.comment: Empire Ruler was good first-up in SA when 3rd behind Winning All Round at Strathalbyn. The rise to the mile looks ideal. Blabber Mouth has been placed at four of his nine starts and was 4th in a recent Morphettville jump-out. Khorasan was good here two runs back running 2nd behind Dirty Deal and then 3rd behind Expecto Patronum at Strathalbyn. Red Ripples ran well behind Mahaler here last week. Rich Melody has been around the mark.

bestBets.overview: PRINCESS DAISY sat handy to the speed in a Morphettville maiden on debut and stuck on okay for fourth despite racing greenly. She's likely to have taken benefit from the race experience. ZEREALM ran home well from back in the field to finish second in a leader dominated race at Strathalbyn last month. GLADIAC comes into this off the back of a 1000m Halidon trial win on August 27th, as does GIFT OF SILENCE. DANCEABLE made a mess of the start in the trial won by Gift Of Silence and did well to finish second. A firmer track might see CHAPPA improve.

raceTips.comment: Princess Daisy was well backed when behind Barghest at Morphettville on debut. Her jump-outs leading in were good and she draws a perfect barrier. Zerealm was good on debut and then narrowly beaten by My Cherie Amor at Strathalbyn last time when she powered late. Danceable is debuting for the Searle/Callanan stable and was good in a recent trial after missing the start. Gift Of Silence debuts for the Clarken/Sorby and won that trial. Nic The Cash ran an improved race at Naracoorte last time.

bestBets.overview: HEART OF THE MED impressed winning this track/trip on debut in April. She has trialled well leading into this and has drawn to get a good run from gate 3. After Sophie Potter's claim, she'll carry 56kg. RICH BRITT raced greenly here when resuming and dug deep to land the prize. She contested a strong race in town last time where she finished midfield. MAYSOONFLY could who up fresh although she will be at her best when she gets over further. Watch market moves for the debutante MANDITO'S MAN who has been going well in jumpouts/trials. ELEGANT LILLY, CHARKA and MISS KASEI are other hopes.

raceTips.comment: Rich Britt was a good winner here two runs back then 9th behind Daisydoo at Morphettville after racing handy to a strong tempo. Heart Of The Med was very impressive winning here on debut and has been runner-up in two recent jump-outs. Big Rita June has ability and in a recent Mindarie Halidon trial. Elegant Lilly has ability and was a Balaklava winner back in Feb. Charka ran well when 3rd behind Whiskey Tumbler at Strathalbyn. Finnbar McCool was a Roxby winner two runs back and then beaten 6.31 lengths in 3rd at Port Augusta. Sarah Rutten also has Mandito’s Man on debut who won consecutive jump-outs before running 2nd in a Mindarie Halidon trial along with Reoffer who was narrowly beaten here two runs back

bestBets.overview: Nothing went the way of DAMELLI when resuming in a stronger race in town. Expecting to see her improve sharply here. HE'S A COOL CAT failed to threaten in stronger company at Morphettville at his latest outing. He'll find this much easier and remains unbeaten here. BRISEIS ECLIPSE was forced to cover ground at Strathalbyn last time and she stuck on gamely to finish second. Drops 1.5kg in weight today and Noel Callow sticks with her. TRANTORO should be nearing peak fitness following three runs back from a break. A firmer track is in her favour.

raceTips.comment: Damelli had no luck first-up running 13th behind Daisydoo at Morphettville. She gets in well and is back in class. Prince Kuro has been racing well and was a narrow winner over The Ice Cutter at Strathalbyn last start. bestBets.overview: TURNED LOOSE chased home all-the-way winner Hamner Springs at Strathalbyn two starts ago. She didn't have the best of luck over 1800m here last time. Look for an improved showing. HEART'S EMBRACE drops in grade after finishing midfield in a bm70 at Warracknabeal last month. She'll be fitter again and is at her best on firm tracks. BADONKIDONK returned to form with a win over this trip at Naracoorte last start. VALUED has finished in the placings in four of his past five runs. He gets his chance to notch up his second career win here. STRATUM PRIDE and EASY BEAST are other hopes.

raceTips.comment: Badonkidonk comes off a soft Bordertown win over Easy Beast who continues to race well. I Love This Song fav beaten 4.45 lengths in that race. Irlandais was 6th in that race but is only one win from 35 starts. Valued has been runner-up at four of his past five the latest at Strathalbyn behind Suit Of Wands. Turned Loose was good when 2nd behind Hamner Springs two runs back and can run well.

bestBets.overview: There were excuses for ROYAL FOX here two starts ago. He improved into the placings here last week even though the drop back to 1400m wasn't ideal. Out to 1600m is a big plus.  MR GEORGE ran a much better race when he got onto a dry track at Warracknabeal last start. He should be around the mark here. MANDARIN rises in grade following a comfortable win in a maiden this route last week.

raceTips.comment: Royal Fox ran well here last week when 3rd behind Final Countdown. He jumps from 1400-1600m which is ideal. Mr George was good last time beaten when 2nd behind Surfy Pete at Warracknabeal. Allegedly was 6th in that race making ground.  Mandarin was impressive breaking his maiden here last week. Youbeeforty was good running 3rd behind Contrary at Balaklava two runs back.
